description: Scrape the followers or following list for TikTok profiles. Input usernames or profile URLs.

includeStats.description: Include follower/following/heart/video counts from statsV2 for each user in the output.
includeStats.title: Include User Stats

listType.description: Choose whether to scrape followers, following, or both lists for each profile. NOTE: 'followers' requires a sessionCookie — without it TikTok's API returns a generic list, not the account's real followers. 'following' works without a cookie.
listType.title: List Type

maxUsersPerProfile.description: Maximum number of follower or following users to fetch per profile.
maxUsersPerProfile.title: Max Users Per Profile

profileUrls.description: TikTok profile URLs as alternative or additional input. E.g. https://www.tiktok.com/@natgeo
profileUrls.title: Profile URLs

sessionCookie.description: Value of the TikTok `sessionid` cookie. **Required to scrape followers** — without it, TikTok's API ignores the target account and returns a generic regional list. Not needed for 'following' mode. To obtain: install Cookie-Editor extension → log into TikTok → click Cookie-Editor → find 'sessionid' → copy its Value.
sessionCookie.title: TikTok Session Cookie (required for followers list)

usernames.description: TikTok usernames (with or without @) to fetch followers/following for.
usernames.title: Usernames

title: TikTok Followers/Following Scraper Input
